items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
#Magic forward Paolo Banchero told @orlandosentinel.com last night he tweaked his right ankle to the inside during the 1st quarter.

“Most of all my ankle sprains have always been to the outside, so this is kind of foreign to me,” he said. “So a little scary in that way.”
